subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar adopt this model-activity card as the supported standalone share-artifact direction once the PNG renderer regression is repaired?
rationale: The related canonical design discussion remains open, and the patch introduces a substantial new user-facing presentation and data contract rather than a pre-defined bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed repair
options.body: Approve this visual direction contingent on retaining `ImageRenderer`, refreshing exact-head runtime proof, and keeping future native sharing separate.

options.title: Defer to the design discussion
options.body: Keep the existing card and resolve the information-architecture direction in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2290 before accepting a replacement artifact.

options.title: Adopt only the data hardening
options.body: Split reusable source/coverage correctness work from the visual redesign and reconsider the card separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed repair
recommendation.body: Approve this visual direction contingent on retaining `ImageRenderer`, refreshing exact-head runtime proof, and keeping future native sharing separate.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current product discussion and directly reviewed the renderer behavior on this PR.
